part5.q: Suppliers must submit their proposals ------- the deadline stated in the contract.

part5.q: The facilities manager is responsible for ------- that all lease agreements are up to date.
part5.ex: 介系詞 for 後面用動名詞 ensuring；ensure/ensures/ensured 皆不合語法。

part5.q: ------- all candidates are qualified, the hiring manager will schedule interviews next week.
part5.ex: Since 表示『既然...』合句意，Although、Unless、After 不合語境。

part5.q: No equipment will be delivered ------- the supplier receives a signed contract.
part5.ex: until 表示『直到...才』，最符合語意；unless (除非) 容易誤選，但語意不同。

part5.q: The supplier’s performance will be reviewed ------- the end of the contract period.

part5.q: Management is seeking an ------- solution to address complaints about the real estate leasing process.
part5.ex: solution 需搭配形容詞 effective（有效的）；名詞、副詞、過去分詞皆不符。

part5.q: The volunteers ------- setting up the event were praised for their dedication.
part5.ex: who 用於形容代表人，修飾 volunteers；which(物)、whose(所有格)、whom(受格)皆不合文法。

part5.q: Our company plans to ------- additional staff before the busy season begins.
part5.ex: plans to 後接原形動詞 hire；hired/hiring/hires 語法錯誤。

part5.q: Early ------- to the supplier contract allowed both companies to avoid misunderstandings.
part5.ex: clarification (名詞)為正確答案，形容說明的動作；clarifying (動名詞)不合文法。

part5.q: Many companies rely on professional staging services to ------- their properties to potential tenants.
part5.ex: to 後接原形動詞 showcase 合文法，其他選項皆不合。

part5.q: The new marketing campaign was designed to ------- brand awareness among younger consumers.
part5.ex: to 後需原形動詞 boost，boosting/booster/boosted 都不能作為此句動詞使用。

part5.q: ------- the training program varies by department, all new employees must complete it within one month.
part5.ex: 雖然各部門課程內容不同，but 皆要一個月內完成，Although 正確；Despite 易誤選但後需名詞。

part5.q: The company is implementing new ------- measures to prevent unauthorized access to its data systems.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 security，這裡需要一個名詞來修飾 measures。secure 是形容詞，secured 和 securing 用法皆不正確。

part5.q: Donors who ------- more than $500 will receive special recognition at the charity fundraiser banquet.
part5.ex: 這裡是限定詞子句，who 後面要用原形動詞 (動詞一致)，故選 contribute。contributed 和 contributing 都語法不合。

part5.q: All employees must attend the product launch, ------- they have obtained prior approval for absence.
part5.ex: unless 表示“除非...否則”，符合句意。if 和 because 會改變句子意思，as 用於表示原因而非條件。

part5.q: Due to the market demand, the real estate agents recommend signing a lease ------- at least one year.
part5.ex: sign a lease for [period of time] 是正確搭配。on, of, with 都不正確。

part5.q: Access to sensitive files should be ------- to authorized personnel only.
part5.ex: should be restricted 是被動語態，意指“應被限制”。restrict 是原形，restricting 和 restrictive 不合語法或語意。

part5.q: The board meeting agenda includes topics ------- financial performance and upcoming projects.
part5.ex: such as 用來舉例，符合語意。despite、owing to、even if 都不正確。

part5.q: The IT security team ------- a new software update last month to address recent threats.
part5.ex: last month 表示過去時間，需用過去式 released。has released 是現在完成，與線索詞不符。

part5.q: Property owners should ensure that all leasing agreements are ------- reviewed before signing.
part5.ex: reviewed 需要副詞修飾，thoroughly 為副詞。thorough (形容詞)、through (介系詞)、thoroughness (名詞) 均不適用。

part5.q: Anyone ------- is interested in volunteering at the charity event can sign up at the information desk.
part5.ex: who 可用來指人當主詞，符合句意。whose 為所有格，whom 作受詞，which 指物。

part5.q: A detailed ------- will be sent after the product launch to summarize the feedback from attendees.
part5.ex: 需要一個名詞做主詞，故選 report。reporting 是動名詞，reported 和 reporter 都不是正確答案。

part5.q: The keynote speaker at the community event ------- to address the importance of environmental awareness.
part5.ex: 句型為 be expected to，表示“預期要”，符合語意。expected 是過去式，was expecting 和 expects 語法不正確。

part5.q: To access the conference call, please log in ------- the secure company portal.
part5.ex: log in through 某個平台是常用說法。by, at, along 都不合語意。

Customer Feedback Survey: Shipping Delays – March

Thank you for participating in our survey about your recent experience with FastShip Logistics. Below are summary results from 250 respondents:

- 62% reported that their orders arrived later than the estimated delivery date.
- Of those with delays, 48% indicated they were not notified in advance.
- 36% stated that delayed shipments led to disruptions in their own business operations.
- Top causes identified by customers: insufficient tracking information (47%), lack of customer support response (32%), and unclear expected delivery times (21%).
- 74% of all respondents said they would use FastShip Logistics again if improvements are made.

Survey participants suggested the following improvements:
- More accurate tracking updates
- Better communication regarding delays
- Faster response to customer inquiries

To announce a change in shipping policies
To advertise a shipping service to new customers
To provide instructions for returning delayed orders

qs.ex: A是正確的，47% 的顧客指出追蹤資訊不足是主要問題。B為常見但未於文件提及的問題。

o: To confirm that onboarding preparations for a new hire are in order

o: She was probably a recent graduate when hired.

qs.q: In the e-mail, what is the closest meaning to 'arrangements'?
qs.ex: 正確答案是A，'arrangements'在此指準備。B為約會，C為合約，D為指示，皆與文意不符。

part5.q: The supplier’s contract will not be ------- until both parties have signed all the necessary documents.
part5.ex: 正確答案為 valid，意思是“有效的”；最容易混淆的選項是 validate（動詞），但句子需要形容詞修飾 contract。

part5.q: The company requires that all warranty claims ------- within 30 days of purchase.
part5.ex: be submitted（被動語態原形）正確，因為 require that 子句需用虛擬語氣；is submitted 錯誤，時態不符。

part5.q: New employees are provided with an onboarding booklet ------- outlines the company’s safety policies.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 that，引導限定用法的關係子句；which 在這裡需有逗號分隔但原句無逗號，因此不正確。

part5.q: Please review the catering order carefully ------- confirming your reservation.
part5.ex: before（在...之前）邏輯正確；despite（儘管）語意不符，因此是常見混淆選項但不正確。

part5.q: Employees must wear protective equipment ------- working in the factory.
part5.ex: while（在...的同時）用於描述條件，正確；unless（除非）常被學習者誤選，但語意不符。

part5.q: The safety inspector ------- the factory last week to ensure compliance with new regulations.
part5.ex: visited（過去式）正確，“last week”暗示過去發生；was visiting 表持續但無法與 last week 搭配單次事件。

part5.q: Customer complaints should be addressed ------- to maintain the company’s reputation.
part5.ex: promptly（副詞）修飾動詞 addressed 是正確用法；promptness（名詞）不能修飾動詞。

part5.q: After reviewing your warranty claim, we regret to inform you that it ------- the required criteria.
part5.ex: does not meet（現在式，主詞 it）正確；do not meet（主詞複數）常見混淆但語法錯誤。

part5.q: ------- the new supplier has lower prices, their delivery speed is much slower.
part5.ex: Although（雖然）正確表達讓步；because（因為）語意不符這個句子的邏輯。

part5.q: The catering manager requested a detailed ------- of the items needed for the event.
part5.ex: list（名詞）正確，需要一份清單；listing 偏向類似“刊登”而不是指清單本身。

part5.q: The factory workers receive ------- training on emergency procedures every year.
part5.ex: safety（名詞）正確修飾 training；safely（副詞）不能修飾名詞 training。

part5.q: The contract outlines ------- of both the supplier and the client in detail.
part5.ex: responsibilities（名詞複數）正確，指雙方的責任；responsibility（單數）也有可能但 less natural 因為談的是雙方。

part5.q: The onboarding program is designed ------- new employees adapt quickly to their roles.
part5.ex: to help（to V 原形）設計目的用法正確；helping（動名詞）不能和 be designed 直接搭配目的。

part5.q: If the equipment is found to be defective, the manufacturer will replace it ------- additional cost.
part5.ex: without additional cost（無需額外費用）為正確慣用語；in additional cost 不合語法。

part5.q: The customer service team responded ------- to complaints received over the weekend.
part5.ex: quickly（副詞）修飾動詞 responded 是正確的；quick（形容詞）不能修飾動詞。

part5.q: The factory must strictly adhere ------- the safety protocols at all times.
part5.ex: adhere to（遵守）是固定片語；其他介系詞搭配皆不合用法。

part5.q: Please submit the signed contract ------- you have reviewed all its terms and conditions.
part5.ex: after（在...之後）語意合邏輯；unless（除非）意義完全相反，因此不對。

part5.q: The catering company offers a wide ------- of menu options for corporate events.
part5.ex: variety of（各式各樣的）是固定搭配；various 是形容詞，不能接 of menu options。

part5.q: To submit a warranty claim, please fill out the online ------- provided on our website.
part5.ex: form（表單）指具體的文件；最容易混淆的是 formation，但它是“形成”的意思，不符語意。

part5.q: We sincerely apologize ------- any inconvenience the delayed delivery may have caused.
part5.ex: apologize for（因...而道歉）為正確搭配；apologize to 是“向...道歉”，對象不同。

part5.q: To improve punctuality, the city is ------- new tracking systems for its bus fleet this year.
part5.ex: 正確答案為implementing，是現在進行式動名詞，表示目前正在進行的動作；'implemented'是過去式，語意不符。

part5.q: The company’s onboarding program ensures that new staff members are ------- with all necessary resources.
part5.ex: 正確答案為provided，被動語態說明新員工被提供資源；'providing'為主動進行式，語意不符。

part5.q: Many residents rely ------- public transportation to commute to work every day.
part5.ex: 正確答案為on，'rely on'是固定搭配；'rely of'或其他選項用法皆錯誤。

part5.q: Complaints ------- in the past month indicate a decline in customer satisfaction.
part5.ex: 正確答案為received，過去分詞作complaints的修飾語；'receiving'常誤選但語法錯誤。

part5.q: We should confirm the event schedule ------- printing the promotional posters.
part5.ex: 正確答案為before，'before printing'表示在印海報前；'until'用法錯誤。

part5.q: If you have any ------- regarding the interview process, please contact our HR department.
part5.ex: 正確答案為questions，前有any表複數；'question'單數不適用。

part5.q: The new bus routes were designed to increase the ------- of public transportation in suburban areas.
part5.ex: 正確答案為convenience，作為抽象名詞；'convenient'為形容詞，語法錯誤。

part5.q: The community event is open to anyone ------- wants to get involved in local projects.
part5.ex: 正確答案為who，指人且當主詞；'which'不能指人。

part5.q: During the fundraiser, volunteers must ------- donations from guests at the registration desk.
part5.ex: 正確答案為collect，must後需用動詞原形；'collected'為過去式或分詞，用法錯。

part5.q: Candidates ------- show strong communication skills are highly sought after.
part5.ex: 正確答案為who，關係代名詞連接句子；'when'表時間，語意不符。

ensure 是最合適的動詞型態，to + 動詞原形表示目的。'Ensures' (第三人稱單數) 在此文法錯誤，'ensuring' 和 'ensured' 不符文法需求。

o: If you require gluten-free options, please specify the number of meals needed.
We will deliver the food at 8:00 p.m., as previously agreed.
The server uniforms will be black and white.
Please confirm the room number as soon as possible.
qs.ex: 只有第一句與特殊飲食需求有關，呼應前文提到的過敏和飲食限制話題。其他選項與上下文無直接關聯（運送時間、服務生服裝、會議室號碼）。
Once confirmed（確認後）正確銜接之前要求確認的句子。'Firstly' 在此並無列舉意義，'Despite that'、'As a result' 意思皆不符。
